dmp.description:
This project focuses on developing selective inhibitors for human carbonic anhydrase IX and XII, isoforms
associated with solid tumors and chemotherapy resistance. By employing high-throughput and crystallography-
based fragment screening, we aim to identify tailored fragments for these isoforms, uncover known carbonic
anhydrase inhibitor class binding mechanisms, or potentially reveal new inhibitor classes. Additionally, a
structural and kinetic analysis will be performed on previously established scaffold derivatives for its further
development of ultimate goal – isoform selective human carbonic anhydrase IX or XII inhibitor. The project
addresses a crucial need for a more comprehensive structural research strategy in isoform-selective inhibitor
design.
